20261122-chemistry-e2-2.title: Ndechipi chikonzero chekuti kunyangwe
20261122-chemistry-e2-2.goal: Shandisa misimboti ye Ndechipi chikonzero chekuti kunyangwe kugadzirisa dambudziko reongororo.
20261122-chemistry-e2-2.material: Ndechipi chikonzero chekuti kunyangwe ukaisa mvura nemafuta ekubikisa mubhodhoro rimwe ukazunza zvakanyanya, kana wasiya zvakadzikama kwechinguva zvinodzokera kupatsanurwa mumatanho maviri?
20261122-chemistry-e2-2.s.s1.prompt: Ndechipi chikonzero chekuti kunyangwe ukaisa mvura nemafuta ekubikisa mubhodhoro rimwe ukazunza zvakanyanya, kana wasiya zvakadzikama kwechinguva zvinodzokera kupatsanurwa mumatanho maviri?
20261122-chemistry-e2-2.s.s1.explain: Mvura imorekuru ine polarity uye mafuta ekubikisa mamorekuru asina polarity, saka haasanganisi, uye density yemafuta ekubikisa (angangoita 0.92 g/cm³) idiki kupfuura yemvura (1.0 g/cm³), saka anoyangarara kudanho repamusoro.
20261122-chemistry-e2-2.s.s1.hint.0: Mvura ine polarity uye mafuta haana polarity, saka haanyungudike pamwe.
20261122-chemistry-e2-2.s.s1.hint.1: Mafuta akareruka kupfuura mvura (density diki) saka anoyangarara pamusoro.
20261122-chemistry-e2-2.s.s1.o.o0: Nekuti mafuta ekubikisa ane hunhu hwekusanganisa nemvura asi ane density diki kupfuura mvura, saka anoyangarara pamusoro
20261122-chemistry-e2-2.s.s1.o.o2: Nekuti mvura inodziya kupfuura mafuta ekubikisa
20261122-chemistry-e2-2.s.s1.o.o3: Nekuti mafuta ekubikisa akaomarara kuita chakasimba
